summary: HEAD matches fix-2's stated NEW HEAD (4198c3f70), working tree clean at every point in this recheck, including after two deliberate breaks I introduced and restored myself. The prior recheck (round 1) left exactly one open item, RECHECK-C2-SPEC-01 (major, AC3's missing two-build-cutover-drill statementFacts leg). Fix round 2 built that leg instead of arguing the escalation further. I independently verified this is genuinely done, not merely claimed: the diff (b7e771799..HEAD) adds a third leg to packages/runtime/tests/two-build-cutover-e2e.mjs and a matching statementFacts branch to tests/two-build-serve.mjs, confirmed by reading both files directly. I built my own fresh clara_rt_test clone (dropped and recreated twice), bootstrapped its WDK World, and ran the drill three times. The first two runs failed for reasons that turned out to be purely environmental, not code defects: run 1 hit 'pollDocTask timeout' because clara_l02's seed carries 224 non-terminal document_processing_tasks that a served image's own reconciler picks up and contends with the drill's freshly-queued task once the accounting_work rows alone are cleared; run 2 (after clearing those too) hit 'image A2 did not become ready' because clara_l02's seed also carries hundreds of live wake/chat_turn/close_prep agent_tasks (564 in my clone) that get really processed by a served image and can mint real non-terminal chatTurn_v21 runs before the next scratch image (deliberately built without chatTurn_v21) boots and refuses to start over stranded bodies. Neither failure touches statementFacts logic; both are pre-existing legs (claraWork, chatTurn) tripped by unrelated seed volume. On a THIRD attempt, after quiescing every non-terminal row across agent_tasks (wake, chat_turn, close_prep, accounting_work) and document_processing_tasks to a terminal state, the drill ran clean end to end: 'TWO-BUILD CUTOVER E2E: ALL PASS', with the log showing all three legs completing, including 'S1 parked on statementFacts_v3 ... RESUME S1: settled on statementFacts_v3 inside build B (run name invariant), 3 lines, none cited' and 'S2: 3 lines admitted inside build B on statementFacts_v4, every one citing its page and the region's own locator' — exactly the shape the fix report describes, and this also closes AC1's previously-qualified World wrapper, since S2 is a real statementFacts_v4 run inside a bootstrapped WDK World started by the reconciler. I then independently reproduced the fix report's own vacuity control rather than trusting its prose: I broke attachStatementLineCitations in packages/runtime/workflows/statementFacts.v4.citations.mjs to return lines unchanged, rebuilt, re-quiesced a fresh clone, and reran the drill — it failed with the byte-identical assertion text the fix report quotes ('AssertionError: line 1 cites page 1 — the page the seeded region's own locator carries (got null)'), with the S1 half still green (RESUME S1 logged as before). I restored the file byte for byte and confirmed git diff/status were empty before rebuilding again. This is non-vacuous, independent proof that the new leg's S2 half genuinely exercises the citation-attachment code path rather than passing by construction. Every other gate was re-run and matches both fix reports exactly: statement-facts-v4-citation.test.mjs 10/10, statement-facts-v4-citation-db.test.mjs 7/7, f-a2-statement-activation.test.mjs 12/12, registry-view.test.mjs 7/7, f-a2-statement-header-v3.test.mjs 21/21; check-frozen-workflows OK (327 files, 322 unchanged + 5 additions, 3 retired); check-worker-paths, check-workflow-bundle (58 superseded bodies still ship, 46 checks) and check-parts-parity all OK; pnpm typecheck exit 0; CI=true GITHUB_ACTIONS=true pnpm lint exit 0; pnpm --filter @clara/runtime build exit 0 with grep -c renderedRegionIndexes .output/server/index.mjs = 3; the whole runtime suite once: 2990 tests, 2950 pass, 2 fail (verified by name: #693 EICAR scanner and #806 pg_dump/psql absent, both RIG.md-named Windows-only reds, 0 new failures, byte-identical to both fix reports' own counts), 38 skipped; bank-match-walk e2e on the lane's own Playwright triple: 6/6 passed. git diff --name-only 6da02a8de..HEAD and b7e771799..HEAD confirm no apps/web path, no migrations/ path, no chatTurn/claraWork BODY file (only the shared drill harness, which is additive and whose own chatTurn/claraWork legs I watched complete successfully in every one of my three runs) and no CONTEXT.md edit this round (correctly, since no new vocabulary was introduced). clara_l02, the actual lane database, was never touched by any of this verification: to_regclass('workflow.workflow_runs') on it is still null and it still carries 309 files at the end, so rig-isolation T10b stays green; all drill runs and the vacuity probe used throwaway clara_rt_test clones that I created and dropped myself. Nothing above minor remains open.

findings.title: The fix report's own recipe for recreating the two-build drill's database ('The drill's database, and how to recreate it') under-states what needs quiescing on a heavily-seeded clara_l02 clone, and a literal follow of it can reproduce a spurious failure in the PRE-EXISTING chatTurn/claraWork legs
findings.evidence: waveC-lane02-fix-2.md's recipe mentions settling '28 unbound accounting_work tasks ... then 161 non-terminal document_processing_tasks' on the clara_rt_test clone. Following that recipe literally on my own fresh clone (a clara_l02 template clone taken at end-of-round-2) was not enough: after clearing exactly those two categories, the drill failed with 'image A2 on <port> did not become ready' / '[clara-runtime] stranded bodies n=8 names=chatTurn_v21 — REFUSING TO START THE DURABLE WORLD', traced to clara_l02 carrying 276 running wake tasks, 186 queued chat_turn tasks, 30 awaiting_input chat_turn tasks and 54 running close_prep tasks (564 total) that a served image's real reconciler processes for real once build A boots, occasionally minting a handful of genuine non-terminal chatTurn_v21 runs before build A2 (deliberately built without chatTurn_v21, to test the rollback path) starts and refuses over exactly those stranded runs. This is not a defect in #1037's own code — both failing legs (claraWork, chatTurn) predate this ticket and are untouched by its diff, and the SAME drill passed cleanly, all three legs, once every non-terminal row across every agent_tasks kind was quiesced first. It is worth recording because clara_l02's live-state volume only grows as more lanes and review rounds run fixtures against it, and the next person to reproduce this drill from the fix report's own recipe (the hosted-release integrator, or a future reviewer) will hit the same false failure unless they clear the wider set.
findings.required_fix: None in this lane (the code is correct; the gap is in a report's recipe, and the report is not a gate the lane's own acceptance criteria depend on). Worth a one-line addition to waveC-lane02-fix-2.md's recipe, or to RIG.md's two-build-cutover-e2e.mjs guidance, naming that ALL non-terminal agent_tasks kinds (not just accounting_work) and document_processing_tasks should be quiesced on a clara_l02-derived clone before running the drill, not only the two categories the door itself refuses on.
